title: +87% upside: $QMCO $14.47 to $27 on the analyst mean target
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Quantum Corp's $27 target is the average of three analyst targets ($29, $29 and $24). From about $14.47, reaching it would take roughly an 87% gain. The ratings lean bullish (Strong Buy or Moderate Buy), and Cantor Fitzgerald recently started coverage at Overweight. Support comes from a debt-reduction turnaround, the company's spot in the "cold data" storage tier of AI infrastructure, and improving revenue. The risks are persistent net losses, extreme volatility (a 52-week range of $4.19 to $35.65) and a beta near 3. This is a target, not a promise.

Full analysis: https://tickeron.com/blogs/quantum-corporation-qmco-analyst-targets-suggest-87-upside-potential-33185/
